references.observed: Ordinary crest photograph shows dark, ribbed central apron beneath the road deck and four separate chutes on the far southern flank.
Operator reports a 770 m crest, 1180 m road elevation, 1170.5 m full supply, and four 15 by 9.5 m radial gates on the left flank. The station is underground.
The named attraction and reservoir, crest road, Orange River downstream polygon and underground station POI jointly identify Vanderkloof.
